verdicts.decision_note: The client establishes the system-enforced rule that only already-minted NFT codes are valid and future token IDs must be rejected to prevent self-referral.
First concrete failure: the system accepted code 5 despite the already-minted-NFT validation rule.
The client specifies the product copy rendered for valid and blank-or-invalid referral-code results; no existing state key becomes obsolete.
Target-specific post-failure claim: the enumerated minted, unminted, and blank referral-validation fixes are reported live for testing.
First concrete post-claim verification of the invalid-code feedback path: the client observed the message and judged its presentation successful before changing its wording.
The client changes the product copy displayed for blank or invalid referral codes; the existing copy key is replaced in place and requires no removal.
Distinct valid-code path verification: the client completed a mint using offered referral code 3 and observed the resulting NFT.
